entries.1c244e36d073deff: Founded in 1970 in Kisarazu, Chiba Prefecture, the company transitioned to a holding company structure in April 2024. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Growth Market, and the group consists of two companies in total: the company and one consolidated subsidiary (Wakuwaku Hiroba Co., Ltd.). Consolidated employees as of September 30, 2025 numbered 59.
entries.1fe8236333984341: This business provides a sharing service that makes the company group's sales floor space available as a sales venue to regional producers and food manufacturers. It operates direct-sales stores nationwide under the Wakuwaku Hiroba brand, and as of September 30, 2025, it operated 182 stores (153 mall stores and 29 street-front stores). Store operations are handled by consolidated subsidiary Wakuwaku Hiroba Co., Ltd., and the number of registered producers is 33,906. Consolidated operating revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥7,982 million. Its head office is located in Mihama-ku, Chiba, Chiba Prefecture, and as of September 30, 2025, consolidated headcount was 59.
entries.254dc94727204aaa: It is explained that while the sales amount of the agricultural production-related business through farm produce direct-sales stores has grown, the number of supermarkets operating direct-produce vegetable corners has also increased, and competition has become intense. The group seeks to position itself as a “direct-sales plaza connecting regions” that broadly gathers local foods, not only fresh produce but also bento, side dishes, breads and processed foods; it is a mid-sized platform operating direct-sales stores, with operating revenue of ¥7,982 million and 182 stores nationwide.
entries.2b0064c4a4abadec: Roadside street-front stores; as of September 30, 2025, there were 29 stores. The company also plays a role as local living infrastructure, and in addition to producers' products, sells staple goods, mainly daily necessities purchased from manufacturers and others, as inventory of the company group.
entries.3a11e5d114f745ee: This is a store format in which stores are opened as tenants inside shopping malls, and as of September 30, 2025, there were 153 stores, accounting for more than 8-tenths of all stores.

entries.4e3f345b3bb3af4b: In the fiscal year ended September 2025, 16 new stores were opened while 22 were closed, and the number of stores at fiscal year-end fell to 182 from 188 at the end of the previous fiscal year. This is the result of advancing scrap-and-build of unprofitable stores and remodeling of existing stores, and the expansion of “places” is at a stage of reviewing the quality of store openings. On the other hand, the number of registered producers increased by 2,248 from the end of the previous fiscal year to 33,906, and the expansion of “users” continues.
entries.601675338b79a22a: Provision of sales space and store operation of “Wakuwaku Hiroba” (mall stores and street-front stores)
entries.751abff6162803e4: Through 182 “Wakuwaku Hiroba” stores (153 mall stores and 29 street-front stores), the company provides registered producers with sales space and conducts store operations such as sales floor management and cash register operations. Producers list vegetables and fruit, bento, side dishes and bread, processed foods, Japanese and Western confectionery, seasonings, flowers and others.
entries.8505eb7e38c0ef4e: Consignment sales of producers’ products (vegetables and fruit, bento, side dishes and bread, processed foods, Japanese and Western confectionery, seasonings, flowers)
entries.884b88bb830b9b5c: A holding company of the share shop business, which operates "Wakuwaku Hiroba," direct-sales stores where local producers list their food products, at 182 stores nationwide.
entries.89e80ed5ef90ef14: General consumers who visit the stores
entries.8c38959975d415e4: Producers that list products include farmers, restaurants, side-dish shops, bakeries, Japanese and Western confectionery shops in the areas around the stores, and food manufacturers across Japan; the number of registered producers is 33,906. Those who purchase products are general consumers who visit the stores.
entries.ac3ab07fcc853823: Local producers and food manufacturers that list their products
entries.b14b308da2069433: Its strength lies in a consignment sales structure in which the group does not bear inventory risk for products listed by producers. Producers bear no registration fees or deposits and need no capital investment, and can freely decide when, what, how many and at what price to list, so even small-scale producers can use sales space in malls with strong drawing power. A local supply chain of producers around the stores is gradually forming, and store sales tend to build up over time; in addition, store facilities are limited to display tables, refrigerated cases, cash registers and similar, so simple and low-cost operation is also a feature.
entries.b996ead747a64b1d: General consumers who visit the malls
entries.c2f875129b63f990: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥401 million.
entries.d2a188db4c2e0b15: Its vision is “Creating a world where peace of mind and smiles spread,” and through operating “Wakuwaku Hiroba,” it aims, together with producers, to build destination stores that customers visit deliberately, carrying products that cannot be bought at other stores. It recognizes that the key to platform growth is expanding the number of stores, which are the “places,” and the number of registered producers, which are the “users,” and its policy is to expand total distribution value by opening stores through deepening regional dominance and expanding into areas where it has no stores yet, and by increasing registered producers through building systems that make it easier for producers to list products.
entries.ec45a343ee72dfe0: Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥7,982 million. The breakdown is: for sales of producers’ products, the net amount after deducting payments to producers from sales proceeds, ¥6,923 million; and others (sales of directly purchased products, sales proceeds of price tag stickers, rental income from real estate, etc.), ¥1,058 million.
